description.zh: 数据变更工单ID，可通过调用接口[ListOrders](~~144643~~)获取该参数的值。
description.en: The ID of the data change ticket. You can call the [ListOrders](~~144643~~) operation to query the ID of the data change ticket.

description.zh: 实际调用API的用户的阿里云账号UID。<props="china">更多信息，请参见[指定API调用者](~~2835451~~)。</props>
description.en: The UID of the Alibaba Cloud account of the user who actually invokes the API.<props="china">For more information, see [Specify an API caller](~~2835451~~).</props>

description.zh: 租户ID，可通过调用接口[GetUserActiveTenant](~~198073~~)获取该参数的值。
description.en: The ID of the tenant. You can call the [GetUserActiveTenant](~~198073~~) operation to query the tenant ID.

title.zh: 重新执行数据变更工单预检查
title.en: Re-execute the precheck of a data change ticket

descriptions.zh: 仅管控模式为安全协同的数据库实例可调用此API。
descriptions.en: This API can be invoked only for database instances whose control mode is Security Collaboration.
